chapter_mission: Cinderline begins the prison snatch under false procedural cover. Lysa manipulates systems; Talon reads the pattern before Ben can. The first snatch team breaches the wing. Ben breaks cover and saves Talon physically, disabling rather than killing and protecting confused prison staff. His restraint is active, not passive — he chooses non-lethal Force work and lightsaber control even when speed would be easier.
chapter_turn: Ben can win the fight, but Talon says they are going the wrong way.
